description: This source file implements device processor status APIs, including CPU usage calculation, for a TR-069 host interface. It manages instances, retrieves CPU stats from /proc/stat, and provides CPU usage data.

classes.name: hostIf_DeviceProcessStatusInterface
classes.description: Class managing device process status, including CPU usage retrieval and instance management.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance for a device ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns list of all device instances.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and deletes a specific device instance.

methods.name: getProcessStatusCPUUsage
methods.description: Calculates CPU usage percentage over a 1-second interval.

methods.name: get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_CPUUsage
methods.description: Provides CPU usage data for TR-069 interface, indicating if data has changed.
